title: Models, Enums, DTOs, Events & Exceptions
intro: Applies to: Eloquent models (with their observers, accessors and casts), enums, domain events, value objects/DTOs, specifications, read models, exceptions.

Lane boundaries: exception types and the not-found carve-out are owned here; `orchestration-di.md` owns the lookup-method rule (`findByXOrFail()` / `findOrFail()`), so do not re-audit it here. Query-shape performance rules (filtering in the database, `$with`, column selection, report queries) are owned by `performance.md`, which builds on the eager-loading rule below.

entries.rule: Casts **MUST** be declared via the `casts()` method, never the `$casts` property.

checks.coverage: Custom rule: report a `$casts` property declared on an Eloquent model.

entries.rule: Models **MUST NOT** declare `$fillable` or `$guarded`. `Model::unguard()` is called globally; input validation lives in Form Requests at the boundary.
entries.why: `Model::unguard()` is called globally; input validation lives in Form Requests at the boundary

checks.coverage: Custom rule: report a `$fillable` or `$guarded` property declared on an Eloquent model.

entries.rule: Strict mode **MUST** be enabled in the app service provider: `Model::shouldBeStrict()` (prevents lazy loading, silently discarded attributes, and missing-attribute access) plus `Model::unguard()`.
entries.why: prevents lazy loading, silently discarded attributes, and missing-attribute access

entries.rule: Relationship methods **MUST** carry return types (`: HasMany`, `: BelongsTo`).

checks.coverage: Report a relationship method on an Eloquent model that has no native return type.

entries.rule: A model using `HasFactory` **MUST** carry the `@use HasFactory<XFactory>` PHPDoc generic.

checks.coverage: Report a model that uses `HasFactory` without a `@use HasFactory<...>` PHPDoc tag.

entries.rule: Business logic **MUST** live in model methods (Tell, Don't Ask). A model holds simple domain methods, finders, invariants, and state transitions; logic spanning multiple aggregates **MUST** live in a handler instead.

A transaction **SHOULD** save one aggregate; other aggregates **SHOULD** be updated by a listener reacting to a domain event. This holds alongside the rule above: the handler coordinates, and the second aggregate changes in a listener.

Model observers and model events **MUST NOT** call `save()` on the row that triggered them; decide every column first and write once. "Model events" means Eloquent lifecycle events (`saving`, `updated`, ...), not domain events. Why: a nested `save()` re-fires the same events and can loop or write twice.
entries.why: a nested `save()` re-fires the same events and can loop or write twice

checks.coverage: Custom rule: report a `save()` call on the triggering model inside an observer or a model-event callback.

entries.rule: Accessors and casts **MUST NOT** run queries; derived values **MUST** be computed from data already loaded. Why: strict mode does not catch it, and a list then runs one query per row.
entries.why: strict mode does not catch it, and a list then runs one query per row

checks.coverage: Custom rule: report a query builder or relationship query call inside an accessor or a cast class.

entries.rule: Queries **MUST** start from `Model::query()`, not `DB::` (production classes), and **MUST** eager-load what they iterate.

checks.coverage: Report production classes that depend on the `DB` facade.

entries.lane_note: Query-shape performance rules (filtering in the database, `$with`, column selection, report queries) are owned by `performance.md`, which builds on the eager-loading rule below.

entries.rule: A query rule used by more than one handler **SHOULD** live in one Specification (or named scope) object instead of being repeated.
Custom traits **MUST NOT** be created; only framework/package traits are allowed (`HasFactory`, `SoftDeletes`, `RefreshDatabase`, ...). Shared behavior goes into a class, not a trait.

checks.coverage: Custom rule: report a trait declared in application code.

entries.rule: Polymorphic models **MUST** have a morph-map entry; FQCNs **MUST NOT** be stored in database columns (see `persistence.md`).

Publicly exposed identifiers **MUST NOT** be enumerable auto-increment integers. Expose a non-enumerable id (ULID, UUIDv7, or snowflake) in URLs and API payloads; the mechanism is the project's choice, the non-enumerability is not.
A read model **MUST** be strictly read-only: no mutating methods, no `create()`/ `update()` calls through it. Mutations belong to the paired write model.
A read model **SHOULD** use a private constructor plus a static factory method (`fromArray()`, `fromRow()`) when it combines data from multiple sources.
Enums **MUST** be backed, case names **MUST** be UPPER_CASE (`case ACTIVE = 'active'`), and the class name carries no suffix.

checks.coverage: Custom rule: report a non-backed enum, a case name that is not UPPER_CASE, or an enum class name ending in `Enum`.

entries.rule: A user-facing enum **MUST** provide a `label()` (or equivalent) helper.

A stateful field that could grow past two states **MUST** be a status enum, not a boolean flag: `status` (`draft`/`active`/`archived`) with `isActive()`-style helpers per state on the model, never a new `is_active` column.
Domain constants **MUST** be referenced through their enum, never string literals scattered through the code.
Events **MUST** be past-tense facts (`MemberSignedUp`, `OrderRefunded`) with no `Event` suffix, and **MUST** be dispatched only after the state change succeeds.

checks.coverage: Report event classes whose name ends in `Event`.

entries.rule: Events **MUST** carry ids and scalars (or value objects), never Eloquent models. The listener loads the entity by id.

checks.coverage: Custom rule: report an event constructor parameter typed as an Eloquent model.

entries.rule: Events **MUST** be pure data: `final readonly`, constructor only, no query or business helper methods. Decisions about an event belong in its listener.

checks.coverage: Custom rule: report a method other than the constructor on an event class.

entries.rule: **MUST** be `final readonly` with constructor property promotion and explicit types.
entries.lane_note: File-shape rules (`strict_types`, `final readonly`, promotion) are owned by `orchestration-di.md`; cross-reference it, do not re-audit them here.

entries.rule: Values with format rules (email, money, date ranges) **SHOULD** be value objects validated once in their constructor, not strings re-checked in each method.

Invariants across related fields (check-in before check-out) **MUST** be enforced in a value object's constructor, not only in Form Request rules. Why: Form Requests never run for imports, jobs or console input. The field rule itself still stays in the Form Request (see `http-api.md`).
entries.why: Form Requests never run for imports, jobs or console input

entries.rule: Domain objects **SHOULD** be created through a named constructor that returns a valid object, not `new` plus setters. This extends the read-model static-factory rule to all domain objects.

A result/value object **SHOULD** own interpretation of its own data (`wasRejected()`, `isHigherThan()`) rather than making consumers branch on raw fields. This carve-out is for result/value objects only; events stay method-free.

Each module **MUST** have a base exception with `render(): JsonResponse`; concrete domain exceptions extend it and override the status code. Exceptions render themselves; controllers never catch them.

checks.coverage: Report domain exception classes in a module that do not extend the module's base exception.

entries.rule: A custom not-found exception **MUST NOT** be invented for a plain id lookup; use `findOrFail()` and let `ModelNotFoundException` become the 404. Custom exceptions are reserved for genuine domain errors needing a specific status or message.
entries.lane_note: exception types and the not-found carve-out are owned here; `orchestration-di.md` owns the lookup-method rule (`findByXOrFail()` / `findOrFail()`), so do not re-audit it here.

entries.rule: An outcome the caller handles in the same flow (try the next coupon, show a price without discount) **SHOULD** be returned as a Result object: a `final readonly` result value object (see DTOs and value objects above). A broken rule that ends the use case **MUST** throw a domain exception, which still renders itself per the base-exception rule above.

Handlers and models **MUST NOT** throw framework or generic exceptions (`NotFoundHttpException`, `RuntimeException`) for business rules; they **MUST** throw a named domain exception. Plain id lookups are the carve-out: `findOrFail()` and its `ModelNotFoundException` stay allowed (see the not-found rule above and the Tell, Don't Ask lookup rule in `orchestration-di.md`).

checks.coverage: Custom rule: report a thrown framework or generic exception (`NotFoundHttpException`, `RuntimeException`) in handler and model classes; `ModelNotFoundException` from `findOrFail()` stays allowed.

entries.lane_note: exception types and the not-found carve-out are owned here; `orchestration-di.md` owns the lookup-method rule (`findByXOrFail()` / `findOrFail()`), so do not re-audit it here.

entries.rule: Complex array parameters/returns **MUST** carry array-shape PHPDoc (`@param list<string>`, `@return array<string, mixed>`).

checks.coverage: Report array parameters and return types that have no PHPDoc value type.

entries.note: File-shape rules (`strict_types`, `final readonly`, promotion) are owned by `orchestration-di.md`; cross-reference it, do not re-audit them here.
